summary: Master database integration with our SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) course. Learn to streamline data workflows and enhance your data management skills.
lede: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) training helps database and business intelligence professionals build and operate database integration packages. Through practical package work, learners profile source data, map fields, apply data-quality rules, configure control flows, deploy packages through SSISDB, and monitor executions to investigate errors and support repeatable loads.
audienceIntro: This SSIS training is designed for professionals who build, operate, govern, or consume SQL Server database integration workflows. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical package development experience rather than a purely conceptual overview.
modules: SSIS Data Profiling and Source Analysis
SSIS Control Flow and Workflow Logic
prerequisites: Working knowledge of relational databases, tables, keys, joins, and basic SQL is recommended. You should be comfortable reading simple T-SQL queries, but advanced programming experience is not required. Coding is not required beyond writing and adapting SQL queries and SSIS expressions. The course teaches advanced topics such as incremental loading, SSISDB operations, and performance tuning at operational application level, with enterprise release automation and AI-assisted monitoring covered conceptually. Bring a laptop if the delivery format supports a hands-on lab environment. TrainingCred or the hosting organization should confirm access to SQL Server Data Tools, a permitted SQL Server sandbox, and suitable sample datasets before delivery.
